lots.title: Provision of Minor Disability Adaptations (Minor Building Works)
lots.description: Draft JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 between the London Borough of Bexley (Employer) and the appointed Contractor, covering the provision of minor disability adaptations (under £1k per order) to residential properties within the London Borough of Bexley under Framework 6278 (Lot 11). Works are instructed by the Contract Administrator through electronic Orders / Works Approval Forms specifying description, priority category, property location, and cost allowance, with no works to commence until a valid Order is issued. The contract bundles JCT 2024 Conditions, Contract Particulars, a Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule, a Contract Specification, a Property Schedule, and any further referenced documents; the Contract Specification and Pricing Schedule bodies are held as separate schedules and not substantively present in this draft T&Cs document.
requirements: Contract executed under the JCT Measured Term Contract 2024, including Conditions of Contract, Contract Particulars, Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule, Contract Specification and all associated contract documents.
Initial Contract Term 1 November 2026 – 31 October 2030, 4 Years Fixed Term, with no extension option stated in this draft T&Cs.
Property portfolio covers all residential property located within the London Borough of Bexley.

All works shall be instructed by the Contract Administrator through electronic works orders; each Order will include description of works, priority category, property location and cost allowance (where applicable); no works shall commence until a valid Order has been issued.

Four priority categories with defined response and completion times: Standard (D) – as programmed, within 15 working days; Urgent (C) – same or next day response, within 5 working days completion; Emergency (B) – immediate response, within 48 hours completion; Hospital Discharge (A) – immediate response, within 24 hours completion.

Payments made in accordance with the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996 and Section 4 of the JCT Measured Term Contract 2024; monthly applications for payment; electronic submission of invoices; final date for payment 30 days; VAT payable at the prevailing rate; all invoices must be submitted within 6 months of order issue.

Contractor must comply with all applicable legislation including Building Regulations 2010, Building Safety Act 2022, CDM Regulations 2015, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations, IET Wiring Regulations BS 7671, Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order, Environmental Protection Act, and Data Protection legislation.
Health and Safety duties under HSWA 1974 and CDM 2015, acting as Principal Contractor where required, and maintaining SSIP-accredited H&S certification (e.g. CHAS).
All staff must hold relevant trade qualifications, hold valid CSCS cards, carry photographic identification, and hold enhanced DBS clearance where required.
Waste disposed of in accordance with the Environmental Protection Act 1990; Contractor must be a registered waste carrier and provide waste transfer documentation on request.

Contract documents comprise: JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 Conditions, Contract Particulars, Contract Specification, Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule, Property Schedule, and any further documents referenced in the Contract.
